repairs: All required common/auxiliary receipt fields require presence and valid types/hash/schema before pairing; jointly absent or invalid fields make paired interpretation ineligible.
Every update repeats its epoch negative-draw digest and its preserved initial-parameter digest; this modifies evidence only.
Scientific and runtime drivers require a new explicit absolute writable project output outside all sealed source trees; no implicit output path or source bytecode writes.

One real complete TRAIN epoch runtime driver accepts a fixed arm, fresh seed0 and native17-batch schedule with tail, per-update wall/peak memory and complete support/teacher denominators; no VALID scoring/checkpoints.
scientific_config_unchanged_fields: All fields except output_dir, which changes from relative implicit destination to null; --output-dir is required.
diff_policy: V1_TO_V2.diff covers every old/new payload file except the diff itself and MANIFEST/SEAL, whose final digests are recorded by the v2 manifest/seal without a self-reference cycle.
limits: A failure/OOM under the shared-window cap is the limit of that check; it does not reject scientific direction or dedicated80GiB feasibility. Runtime observations cannot release or replace the frozen full500-epoch3-seed scientific decision; no quality, novelty or acceptance claim.
